blocks.text: Is chapter ne samjhaya ke computer networks kaise bante, kaam karte, chalte rehte aur mehfooz rehte hain. Table is ki bunyadi istilahat ikatthi karti hai.

blocks.caption: Chapter 1 ki kaleedi istilahat
rows: Computer network
Jure hue computers aur devices jo data, resources aur services share karte hain
Network architecture
Network ka design aur tanzeem: devices kaise jure aur baat-cheet kaise hoti hai
Network topology
Devices aur connections ki tarteeb, jaise bus, star, ring, mesh ya tree
LAN
Chhote ilaqe, jaise ghar, school, daftar ya computer lab, mein devices jorta hai
WAN
Bare ilaqon, jaise shehron, mulkon ya bar-e-azamon, mein networks jorta hai
Internet
Sab se bara public network, duniya bhar ke lakhon devices aur networks jorta hai
Networking devices
Switch, router, modem, NIC aur access point jaisa hardware jo devices jorta aur baat-cheet sambhalta hai
OSI model
Saat layers ka model ke data aik device se doosre tak kaise jata hai
Network protocol
Qawaid jo data ke bhejne, wusool aur samajhne ko control karte hain
IP address
Munfarid pata jo network par device ki pehchan karata hai
Subnetting
Behtar intizam aur security ke liye bare network ko chhote networks mein baantna
Network security
Tareeqe jo networks, devices aur data ko be-ijazat rasai, ghalat istemal ya hamle se bachate hain

items: Networks: qismein (LAN, WAN, Internet), devices, topologies, OSI layers, protocols.
Addressing: IPv4, IPv6, subnetting, NAT; ghar ka Wi-Fi aur us ki security.
Network chalana: diagnostics, performance, load balancing, security, backup, usability banam security.
